cues.en: In this video I'm going to introduce you to the concept of comments in Python.
cues.zh: 這段影片介紹 Python 裡註解的概念。

cues.en: It'll be a fairly short video because comments are pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 影片會很短，因為註解相當簡單。

cues.en: However, they are really important for writing good clean and efficient code that you and other people can understand and work with and adapt.
cues.zh: 但要寫出乾淨、有效率，而且自己和別人都能理解、使用、修改的好程式，註解非常重要。

cues.en: So therefore I think it's worth having a whole video just about comments. So I'm going to start by setting
cues.zh: 所以值得單獨用一段影片介紹。先設定，

cues.en: some variable X to be equal 5 and then if we just type x here then python will print out the value of x which is 5.
cues.zh: 變數 x 等於 5，再輸入 x，Python 就會印出 x 的值，也就是 5。

cues.en: So far nothing particularly weird or new or interesting.
cues.zh: 到目前都沒什麼奇怪、新奇或特別有趣的事。

cues.en: Now I'm going to set another variable and let's say Y equals 3.
cues.zh: 再設定一個變數，例如 y=3。

cues.en: Now before running this code I'm going to put a hashtag here at the beginning of this line.
cues.zh: 執行前，我先在這行開頭加上井字號。

cues.en: Now this is not the way of indicating that this is supposed to be trending on Twitter.
cues.zh: 這不是要把它變成 Twitter 的熱門話題，

cues.en: Instead this is indicating what's called a "comment" in python.
cues.zh: 而是在 Python 裡標記所謂的註解。

cues.en: Now notice what happened to this code when I put the hash tag in the beginning of the line.
cues.zh: 注意，在行首加上井字號後，程式碼發生了什麼事。

cues.en: First of all, all the text turned green instead of being the normal colors.
cues.zh: 首先，所有文字都變成綠色，不再是原本的顏色。

cues.en: Secondly, the font is now italics instead of being straight up.
cues.zh: 其次，字型變成斜體，不再直立。

cues.en: OK so I can run this code again.
cues.zh: 好，再執行一次，

cues.en: No problem.
cues.zh: 沒問題。

cues.en: Nothing has changed.
cues.zh: 沒有任何變化，

cues.en: X is still equal to 5.
cues.zh: x 仍然等於 5。

cues.en: However when I type Y here and request that Python tell me the value of y.
cues.zh: 但如果輸入 y，要求 Python 告訴我 y 的值，

cues.en: I get an error message.
cues.zh: 就會出現錯誤訊息，

cues.en: It says variable Y is not defined.
cues.zh: 說變數 y 尚未定義。

cues.en: Now that may seem a little bit strange because I just defined it right here.
cues.zh: 看起來有點奇怪，因為明明在這裡定義了。

cues.en: But what's happening is that this piece of code or this piece of text I should say is in a comment.
cues.zh: 但問題在於，這段程式碼，應該說這段文字，是註解。

cues.en: And Python ignores any text that's inside a comment which means any text that comes after a hashtag.
cues.zh: Python 會忽略註解裡所有文字，也就是井字號後面的內容。

cues.en: So if you actually want to specify or define y to be equal to three you can delete that hashtag.
cues.zh: 如果真的想指定或定義 y 等於 3，可以刪掉井字號。

cues.en: And now of course Y equals 3.
cues.zh: 現在 y 當然就等於 3 了。

cues.en: So there are two ways to create comments in Python.
cues.zh: Python 裡有兩種建立註解的方式。

cues.en: One way is what I just illustrated and that's having a comment be on its own line.
cues.zh: 一種就是剛才示範的，讓註解獨占一行。

cues.en: So you start with a hash like this and then you can write some useful comment.
cues.zh: 先寫井字號，再寫有用的說明。

cues.en: Maybe you want to say, this is where the variables are defined. And then perhaps later down in the code
cues.zh: 例如「這裡定義變數」，之後在程式更下面，

cues.en: you're going to say, this is where the let's say the functions are defined.
cues.zh: 也許寫「這裡定義函數」，

cues.en: And so on.
cues.zh: 依此類推。

cues.en: And then there's going to be more code here.
cues.zh: 這裡還會有更多程式碼。

cues.en: So this is one way to make comments in python. A second way is to have the comments appearing after a valid line of code.
cues.zh: 這是一種寫註解的方式。第二種，是把註解接在有效的程式碼後面。

cues.en: So in this case we say X equals five.
cues.zh: 例如寫 x=5，

cues.en: And then now I put a hash tag and maybe a comment.
cues.zh: 再放井字號，接著寫註解，

cues.en: Is this used to be two point three.
cues.zh: 例如「這裡以前是 2.3」。

cues.en: So maybe that's relevant for some particular reason that you're implementing in this code.
cues.zh: 也許在你實作這段程式時，這件事有特別意義。

cues.en: And just to prove to you that Python actually will interpret this part of the code I'm even going to set this to be Z.
cues.zh: 為了證明 Python 確實會解讀前面這段程式，我甚至把它改成 z。

cues.en: Now you can see z equals 5.
cues.zh: 可以看到 z 等於 5。

cues.en: So python will still evaluate all of the text before the hash mark as code and anything after the hash mark will be ignored.
cues.zh: Python 仍然會把井字號前的文字當成程式碼執行，後面則全部忽略。

cues.en: And this is just going to be comments for you.
cues.zh: 這些只是留給你看的註解。

cues.en: So the last thing that I want to illustrate to you in this video is a keyboard shortcut for toggling whether a line of code has or doesn't have a comment.
cues.zh: 最後示範一個快速鍵，切換一行程式碼是否加上註解。

cues.en: So on windows you have press control and then the forward slash.
cues.zh: Windows 裡，按 Ctrl 加正斜線。

cues.en: Now notice that as I press control forward slash over and over again that's toggling whether this line starts with a hash or doesn't start with a hash.
cues.zh: 注意，反覆按 Ctrl+/，就會切換這行開頭是否有井字號。

cues.en: So that's just a convenient keyboard shortcut.
cues.zh: 這是很方便的快速鍵。

cues.en: You can also select multiple lines of code and then press control forward slash again.
cues.zh: 也能選取多行程式碼，再按 Ctrl+/。

cues.en: And now I'm toggling whether all of these lines of code are commented or whether they are uncommented.
cues.zh: 這樣就能切換所有選取行，是要註解掉，還是取消註解。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now you know how to create comments in Python and you know a keyboard shortcut for setting an entire line or multiple selected lines to be commented.
cues.zh: 現在你知道如何在 Python 裡寫註解，也知道如何用快速鍵，把整行或選取的多行設成註解。

cues.en: Comments are really useful for helping you organize your code and helping make your code be readable not only to other people but also to yourself.
cues.zh: 註解能協助整理程式，讓程式不只別人看得懂，自己也看得懂。

cues.en: And that's because when you come back to your own code in a week or a month or a year, you're probably going to forget a lot of what you were thinking about when you were first writing the code.
cues.zh: 因為一週、一個月或一年後，再回頭看自己的程式，很可能忘記當初在想什麼。

cues.en: So making comments is really useful to help you remember and understand what the goal of the code is and how the code is organized.
cues.zh: 所以，註解很有助於記住、理解程式的目的，以及它的組織方式。
